# Mike Lawrence - Health and Wellbeing Consultant

> > Mike Lawrence is a UK-based workplace mental health speaker and wellbeing consultant specializing in resilience training, psychological safety, and burnout prevention.

The site features Mike Lawrence's keynote speaking services, corporate wellbeing programs, and the signature 12-Second Shift™ mindfulness technique. Mike is affiliated with MHFA England and provides evidence-based mental health support for organizations and leaders.
